faq_heading: Homes near Sullivan Heights Secondary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Sullivan Heights Secondary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Sullivan Heights Secondary home search find homes?
faq.a: By name: a listing shows up when its description mentions Sullivan Heights Secondary. Ask Jared to watch for nearby homes that leave the school out.

faq.q: How much do homes near Sullivan Heights Secondary sell for?
faq.a: Within 2 km of the school, 406 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,330,500, townhomes $762,000, condos $512,750. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Sullivan Heights Secondary?
faq.a: Within 2 km of Sullivan Heights Secondary the median was 31 days on the market, closing at 97.4% of the list price, with 10% of sales above the list price for the 406 homes within 2 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Sullivan Heights Secondary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Goldstone Park Elementary (0.4 km east), Woodward Hill Elementary (0.5 km south-west) and McLeod Road Traditional (0.5 km north-west).

Sullivan Heights Secondary is a secondary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 6248 144 St. It teaches grades 8 to 12.
Below are the homes currently for sale whose listing mentions Sullivan Heights Secondary, followed by what homes within 2 km of the school sold for.
How the Sullivan Heights Secondary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Sullivan Heights Secondary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 2 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 2 km of Sullivan Heights Secondary sold for

Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 406 homes sold within 2 km of Sullivan Heights Secondary: 134 houses, 249 townhomes and 18 condos. The largest group was townhomes, at a median of $762,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Sullivan Heights Secondary

18 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Sullivan Heights Secondary in a straight line (14 elementary, 2 other, 2 secondary; 3 independent). The closest is Goldstone Park Elementary, 0.4 km away, and the farthest on this list is W E Kinvig Elementary, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is iLearn Secondary School Society (1.7 km); the nearest independent school is Regent Christian Academy (1.6 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Ecole Panorama Ridge Secondary (2.4 km). Other secondary schools close by: iLearn Secondary School Society (1.7 km west), Ecole Panorama Ridge Secondary (2.4 km west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (8-12) is iLearn Secondary School Society, 1.7 km west of Sullivan Heights Secondary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Sullivan Heights Secondary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Surrey school finder. A home a few blocks from Sullivan Heights Secondary can sit in a different catchment.
Go past Sullivan Heights Secondary on a school morning and again mid-afternoon to see the traffic, parking and noise before you offer.

Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median townhome within 2 km of Sullivan Heights Secondary was $762,000, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
Look at iLearn Secondary School Society, the nearest other secondary school, 1.7 km west of Sullivan Heights Secondary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
